display.purpose: Condensed signage lettering. The domain's native register — machine plates, warehouse racking, floor markings. Holds its tightness in Cyrillic where most condensed faces break down.

body.purpose: A humanist sans that reads long-form Bulgarian without fighting it. Condensed type is hostile to a paragraph.

serial.purpose: Stock references, asset tags, breadcrumbs. Anything that identifies rather than describes. Never body text.

plate.purpose: Condensed, uppercase, +0.14em. Stamped-plate lettering for wordmarks, eyebrows and section labels. Never below 11px.

shadows.name: bay-panel
shadows.purpose: A lit top edge, a seating line, and a wide very soft shadow that sits UNDER the panel. Reads as a steel plate resting on a surface, not a card hovering over one.

shadows.name: button-accent
shadows.purpose: A hard 3px offset in graphite. On press the button travels the full 3px and the shadow closes to zero — a physical control being depressed, not a rectangle changing colour.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing token, project-wide. `ease-in` is banned on UI.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Reserved for drawer and sheet transitions.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Colour and border changes on hover and press.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Default state transitions, including the catalogue card lift.

motion.name: duration-focal
motion.purpose: The site's one authored moment: the monthly price counting down as the contract term lengthens. Snaps to target under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: The one action per viewport. Square, with a hard offset shadow it travels into on press.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; background: var(--color-accent, oklch(0.8809 0.1806 94.02)); color: var(--color-graphite, oklch(0.2523 0.004 84.58)); border: 1px solid var(--color-graphite, oklch(0.2523 0.004 84.58)); border-radius: 0; font-family: Commissioner, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.45), 0 3px 0 var(--color-graphite, oklch(0.2523 0.004 84.58)); transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-accent:hover { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.45), 0 1px 0 var(--color-graphite, oklch(0.2523 0.004 84.58)); } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.45), 0 0 0 var(--color-graphite, oklch(0.2523 0.004 84.58)); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, oklch(0.2523 0.004 84.58)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The alternative path on paper. Fills to solid graphite rather than tinting.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-graphite, oklch(0.2523 0.004 84.58)); border: 1px solid var(--color-graphite, oklch(0.2523 0.004 84.58)); border-radius: 0; font-family: Commissioner, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-graphite, oklch(0.2523 0.004 84.58)); color: var(--color-paper, oklch(0.9823 0.0029 84.56)); }

components.name: Bay Panel
components.description: The system's surface. A machined top edge and a wide soft shadow that seats the panel rather than lifting it. `riveted` adds corner screws where a panel should read as a fitted component.
components.html:
Каталог

Реални апарати от нашия склад, с година, състояние и месечна цена на всеки.
components.css: .ds-bay { position: relative; width: 320px; padding: 20px; background: var(--color-paper-raised, oklch(1 0 0)); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, oklch(0.8644 0.013 86.84)); border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.9), 0 1px 0 oklch(0.25 0.01 80 / 0.08), 0 10px 22px -18px oklch(0.25 0.01 80 / 0.55); font-family: Commissioner, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-riveted::before, .ds-riveted::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 7px; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0.55; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, oklch(1 0 0 / 0.55), var(--color-line-strong, oklch(0.6184 0.0146 82.39)) 60%, oklch(0.45 0.01 80 / 0.7) 100%); } .ds-riveted::before { left: 7px; } .ds-riveted::after { right: 7px; } .ds-plate { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: Oswald, 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-ink-subtle, oklch(0.5541 0.0177 67.45)); } .ds-bay-body { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--color-ink-muted, oklch(0.4622 0.0109 78.22)); }

components.name: Availability Badge
components.description: Stock state. Text is generated by the availability engine, never hand-written, so label and state cannot disagree.
components.html: Налична Резервирана Отдадена

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field. Sits on the body-lg step (17px) so iOS Safari does not zoom the viewport on focus — the smallest documented step that clears the 16px threshold.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-family: Commissioner, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.2523 0.004 84.58)); } .ds-input { width: 260px; height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; background: var(--color-paper-raised, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.2523 0.004 84.58)); border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, oklch(0.6184 0.0146 82.39)); border-radius: 2px; font-family: Commissioner, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-ink, oklch(0.2523 0.004 84.58)); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--color-danger, oklch(0.5534 0.1739 38.4)); }

components.description: PLACEHOLDER MARK. A stamped plate carrying an initial, with the wordmark beside it and the temporary-name note set in the serial register — a note on the object, not a tagline.
components.html: ВВендинг под наемвременно име

narrative.overview:
A well-run workshop with the lights on. Everything is labelled, everything is where it should be, and nothing is dressed up. The product is fifteen-year-old refurbished equipment sold to people who will inspect it, so the design's job is to look like somewhere competent work happens — not like a café, and not like a brochure.

The world is built from three materials: graphite for the machines and the structural bands, warm paper for everything you read on, and safety yellow for the one thing you should act on. Safety yellow is the colour of machine labels, floor markings and power-on indicators. It is native to the domain in a way that a soft blue or a coffee brown is not, and it is unclaimed in this market.

The confirmed anti-reference is the Bulgarian vending field itself. Six competitor sites were captured and reviewed: all six lead with a category name over stock photography, none publishes a price, none publishes availability, and five have no contact form at all. Every rule exists to break one of those habits.

Direction history: the first build asserted this world almost entirely through colour — no texture, no frame, no material, one hover lift and nothing else. A review named that as the ceiling. The world was then re-authored against exactly those gaps; the grain, the steel, the rivets, the plate and stencil lettering and the shutter animation all date from that pass.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite, warm paper, safety yellow. No third accent.
Very tight radii (1-4px). Nothing is pill-shaped; a machined edge, not a web card.
Numerals are the hero. Prices, years, dimensions and capacities all set tabular.
Material, not flat. Paper has grain, steel has sheen and machining stripe, panels have a lit top edge and corner rivets.
Condensed signage lettering for display, humanist sans for reading, mono for asset tags.
One authored motion moment on the entire site.
Bulgarian Cyrillic set correctly, which no competitor bothers with.

rules.name: The Yellow Is Not A Status Rule
rules.body: Safety yellow never carries stock meaning. Availability speaks in teal, blue and grey only. If the brand accent could also mean "available", every yellow element on the page becomes ambiguous the moment stock changes.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: At most one yellow control per viewport. Its job is to be the obvious next step; two of them means neither is.

rules.name: The Measured Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every neutral used for text carries its measured ratio in a comment beside its definition. De-emphasis is a design decision; illegibility is a defect.

rules.name: The Bulgarian Letterforms Rule
rules.body: The document carries lang="bg" and the body enables locl. Bulgarian Cyrillic draws в г д и к л п ц ш щ differently from Russian, and without both the browser renders the wrong forms.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any figure a visitor might compare is set with tnum. A price list whose digits do not align reads as careless, and this site is asking to be trusted on numbers.

rules.name: The Eleven Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional text below 11px, footers and micro-labels included. Only non-interactive legal smallprint gets 10px.

rules.name: The No Uppercase Sentences Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is for labels of a few words. Anything approaching a sentence stays in sentence case; all-caps strips the ascenders and descenders we read by.

rules.name: The Padding Not Height Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls are sized with padding plus a minimum height, never a fixed height with centred text. Fixed heights look right until the label wraps or the user scales their text.

rules.name: The Seated Not Floating Rule
rules.body: Shadows sit under an element and stay soft and wide. If a shadow reads as elevation above the page rather than weight upon it, it is wrong. No 0 4px 6px card shadows.

rules.name: The No Nested Cards Rule
rules.body: A tinted panel does not go inside another tinted panel. Cards inside cards read as visual noise; use a divider or a paper step instead.

rules.name: The Rivets Earn Their Place Rule
rules.body: riveted goes on panels that represent a machine or a result — the calculator, the success state. Putting screws on every box makes the device meaningless.

dos: Do lead a page with the offer and a number. "Вендинг машина под наем от 70 €/месец" beats "Вендинг машини" on every measure that matters here.
Do set every comparable figure tabular.
Do carry lang="bg" and locl so Bulgarian letterforms render correctly.
Do size controls with padding and a minimum height.
Do show a missing value as "няма данни" rather than hiding the row. A visible gap is information; a shortened table pretending to be complete is not.
Do publish the measured contrast ratio beside any neutral used for text.
Do keep the body measure at 60ch.
donts: Don't use safety yellow for anything that could be read as a status.
Don't use a generic card shadow. Depth is bay-panel: a lit edge and a wide soft shadow that seats the element, never a 0 4px 6px lift.
Don't spend caution-tape anywhere but the demo banner.
Don't put a tinted panel inside a tinted panel.
Don't round anything into a pill.
Don't set a sentence in uppercase.
Don't use opacity to express a disabled state.
Don't put meaning in a title attribute. It is invisible on a phone and unreachable by keyboard, and the condition-grade rubric is a differentiator, not a tooltip.
Don't spend the focal motion budget twice. One authored moment per surface, and on this site it belongs to the monthly price stepping down as the contract lengthens.
